chunks: Turn towards your Lord and obey Him before the punishment comes upon you when you will not be helped.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to turn back to God before punishment comes?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Az-Zumar underscores the critical window of opportunity for repentance (tawbah) before the inevitable arrival of divine chastisement. It highlights the urgency of sincere submission (islam) to God, warning that once the decree of punishment is executed, intercession or aid will no longer be accessible, a concept often linked to the concept of 'Barzakh' or the seal of deeds.
